# PDFSP — PDF Scene Patch

> Portable, verifiable JSON format for mutating a PDF scene graph — the PDF equivalent of JSON Patch (RFC 6902).

PDFSP defines a portable, verifiable JSON format for describing mutations of a PDF document's scene graph. A patch describes what to change, not how to change it: it can be applied by any conforming engine, replayed on related documents, rebased onto newer revisions, and inverted for rollback.

Version 1.0 (Stable), Apache-2.0. Author: fjjjuv. Reference implementation: pdfbadger (https://github.com/fjjjuv/pdfbadger).

## Documentation

- [Overview](https://fjjjuv.github.io/pdfsp/): what it is and why
- [Specification](https://fjjjuv.github.io/pdfsp/spec.html): full normative spec v1.0 (rendered)
- [Specification source](https://github.com/fjjjuv/pdfsp/blob/main/SPEC.md): raw markdown
- [Examples](https://fjjjuv.github.io/pdfsp/examples.html): worked example documents
- [Full spec for LLMs](https://fjjjuv.github.io/pdfsp/llms-full.txt): complete spec text

## Related specifications

- [PDFDTP — Document Transaction Protocol](https://github.com/fjjjuv/pdfdtp): Carries PDFSP ops inside transactions (ops field, SPEC §3).
- [PDFAD — PDF Agent Descriptor](https://github.com/fjjjuv/pdfad): Declares the id_scheme engines use for element ids (SPEC §5).
